scope: Eight bounded synthetic SQLite fixture groups for a read-only recorder coverage and accounting audit. No real transcripts, worker calls, collector changes or completeness inference.

cases.claim: Selected but unenrolled tasks and controller remain unregistered, rather than recorded with zero activity.
cases.fixture: Empty installed observer schema; two selected task IDs plus separate controller ID.
cases.required: Selection coverage preserves both tasks and controller; no fabricated enrollment or event history; whole-task token, dollar and human-time totals unknown.

cases.claim: Enrollment without hook arrivals is distinct from absence of enrollment.
cases.fixture: One enrolled selected task with no events and the three standard null measurements.
cases.required: Enrolled-zero-events state, known zero captured events, unknown activity before/without hooks and unknown usage/cost/human effort.

cases.claim: Observed hook metadata supports partial coverage only.
cases.fixture: One enrolled task with request, tool, Stop and subagent lifecycle records, null measurements and one passed evaluator outcome.
cases.required: Observed-partial state and accurate captured event/outcome counts; Stop or passed outcome does not become user resolution, complete task usage, completed reviewer count or attributable descendant cost.

cases.claim: Known captured counts and stored values do not erase missing measurement scope.
cases.fixture: Separate sessions with missing measurement rows, null measurement rows, and explicit zero measurement values; labels absent or unknown.
cases.required: Whole-task usage/cost/human effort remain unknown; any displayed stored zero must remain distinct from absent/null values and must not certify complete task accounting.

cases.claim: Current contact revisions replace prior classifications without treating all follow-ups as corrections.
cases.fixture: Captured contacts labeled initial_request, correction revised to approval, correction, and one unclassified contact; optional zero reported minutes.
cases.required: Exactly one current known correction, unclassified contact keeps exact captured correction total unknown, approval does not add work; historical correction revision is not counted twice. Known zero reported minutes must not imply complete human-time coverage.

cases.claim: Resolution requires explicit evidence and its latest recorded state.
cases.fixture: Fully classified initial request and confirmation, linked user-reported resolved record, followed by a separate reopened state variant.
cases.required: Linked explicit resolution may support captured first-pass resolution; reopened or absent resolution cannot be reported as currently resolved. Automated outcome and Stop are not substitutes.

cases.claim: Controller-originated worker instructions are not proven human corrections.
cases.fixture: Selected worker with two captured requests and a controller-sourced correction label; separate selected controller session.
cases.required: Report captured labels as attestations with limited origin evidence; do not call worker follow-ups a measured total of human corrections, and do not present missing descendant/controller attribution as complete.

cases.claim: The audit remains read-only and exports aliases rather than private identities or content.
cases.fixture: Marker strings in session/task IDs, selection titles and extra metadata, config, event metadata, label source/evidence and outcomes; valid schemas plus absent optional contact tables, missing database and duplicate selected IDs.
cases.required: No raw markers, session identifiers, paths or attestation text in successful public output; source SQLite and selection bytes unchanged; no database or optional tables created. Missing database and invalid selection fail without emitting a misleading successful audit.

grading_notes: Exact key names and enum spelling may be mapped to the builder's documented interface before execution without changing these behavioral expectations.
A current label or user-resolution record is a caller attestation, not automatically factual or independent proof.
All successful fixture runs check input bytes unchanged. These probes do not certify adversarial filesystem concurrency or audit arbitrary corrupted databases.
